column1: # Shell commands the guard blocks (Bash and PowerShell tools). One rule per line:
# <ERE, case-insensitive><TAB><reason><TAB><optional ERE: allow when it also matches>
# Matched against the raw hook JSON, so "S" below is the start of a command segment:
# start of text, a quote, ; & | ( ` or an escaped newline.
# git push, git aliases and acli (Jira) writes are checked by ngvu_guardrails.py (parses the
# command; allows only the factory's ticket/epic branch push). This file covers everything else.

column2: deleting branches is a human action
deleting tags or worktrees is a human action
skipping hooks or signing needs explicit human consent
mutating gcloud (deploy, IAM, resources) needs approval
deleting or re-permissioning GCS needs approval
making a resource public needs approval
release scripts push branches/tags; human only
Vault reads print secret values and writes change them; both need approval
